name: CASA
description: A benchmark designed to assess large language model agents' sensitivity to cultural and social norms across web-based tasks such as online shopping and social discussion forums, measuring awareness coverage, helpfulness, and violation rates.
reputation: A recent benchmark that has gained attention for evaluating cultural and social norm sensitivity in LLM agents, but it is not yet a broadly standardized leaderboard.
notes: Evaluates LLM agents' cultural and social awareness in real-world web agent environments, highlighting challenges and improvements via prompting and fine-tuning.
